from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPS(BaseModel):
    """Earnings per share data for one company's filing for the specified period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    ticker: str | None = Field(description="Stock ticker symbol if provided")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="EPS value as reported; losses are negative")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the filing containing the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps: list[CompanyEPS]
